description: Copy an entity in the same room and everything under it (at most 64 entities) as your own new entities, with new ids; the root records forkOf and the original author. The source is not changed. into.pos [x,y,z] is where the copy's root goes; into.parent (optional) attaches it to an entity. The copy must pass the same rules as building by hand: your quota, claims, locks, depth and bounds. Refused if the author marked the source noFork. A write: needs a token. Returns "forked <new root id>". Optional room (default: your current room).
name: world_fork
